followX.title: Follow X
followX.description: Share of the player's sideways movement the camera copies

followY.title: Follow Y
followY.description: Share of jump height the camera copies (it always rises fully with the ground: ramps, rooftops, sky platforms)

fovBoost.title: FOV Boost
fovBoost.description: Extra field of view at max speed

shakeTime.title: Shake Time
shakeTime.description: Roughly how long a full-strength shake takes to die away

tunnelHeight.title: Tunnel Camera Height
tunnelHeight.description: Camera height while a tunnel roof is between it and the runner (the roof is at 2.6)

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Scales shake, landing dips and FOV kicks. 0 holds the camera steady; it is cut down automatically when the player's system asks for reduced motion

lookAhead.title: Look Ahead
lookAhead.description: How much further down the road the camera aims at top speed

pullBack.title: Speed Pull Back
pullBack.description: How far the camera drops back and down at top speed

cinematic.title: Cinematic Start/End
cinematic.description: Circle the runner on the start screen and after a crash, and swoop in when a run starts

firstRowZ.title: First Row Z
firstRowZ.description: Where the first row of obstacles sits at the start of a run

spawnZ.title: Spawn Z
spawnZ.description: Rows are kept filled out to this distance ahead

minGapTime.title: Min Gap (s)
minGapTime.description: Shortest travel time between rows, so gaps widen as speed rises

barStartDistance.title: Bars After (m)
barStartDistance.description: Overhead bars only appear once the run has covered this distance

barChance.title: Bar Chance
barChance.description: Share of blocked lanes that get an overhead bar

padChance.title: Pad Row Chance
padChance.description: Share of rows that are a jump pad in front of a tall block

padVelocity.title: Pad Launch Speed
padVelocity.description: With gravity 26 this peaks about 3.8 units up, well over a tall block

powerUpChance.title: Power-up Chance
powerUpChance.description: Share of rows that put a power-up in the open lane

platformChance.title: Platform Row Chance
platformChance.description: Share of rows that are a ramp-and-rooftop or a step platform

rooftopHeight.title: Rooftop Height
rooftopHeight.description: Too high to jump onto: take the ramp

gapChance.title: Gap Row Chance
gapChance.description: Share of rows that are holes in the road: in one or two lanes (dodge or jump) or across all three (jump)

stonesChance.title: Floating Stones Chance
stonesChance.description: Share of rows that are a chasm crossed on floating platforms

stripChance.title: Boost/Goo Row Chance
stripChance.description: Share of rows with cyan boost strips and green goo

shifterChance.title: Shifting Block Chance
shifterChance.description: Share of rows with a block that slides into the next lane

crusherChance.title: Crusher Chance
crusherChance.description: Share of rows with a block that drops onto a marked lane

tunnelChance.title: Tunnel Chance
tunnelChance.description: Share of rows that are a tunnel: its low roof stops jumps, so only slide or dodge inside

crumbleChance.title: Crumbling Stone Share
crumbleChance.description: Share of path stones (orange rim) that fall soon after you land

skyChance.title: Sky Platform Chance
skyChance.description: Share of rows with a strong pad up to platforms floating high over the road

jumpVelocity.title: Jump Velocity
jumpVelocity.description: With gravity 26 this clears about 1.4 units

segmentCount.title: Segment Count
segmentCount.description: Copies of Segment laid end to end; 7 x 24 reaches past the fog

recycleZ.title: Recycle Z
recycleZ.description: A segment whose near edge passes this z (behind the camera) jumps to the far end

acceleration.title: Acceleration
acceleration.description: Speed gained per second of running

restartDelay.title: Restart Delay
restartDelay.description: Seconds after a crash before input can restart the run

stumbleWindow.title: Stumble Window (s)
stumbleWindow.description: A second stumble within this long ends the run

label.title: Capture Label
label.description: 'baseline' stores the reference captures; any other label compares against them

barAction.title: Bar Action
barAction.description: What the bot does at an overhead bar: 'slide' (should pass), 'none' or 'jump' (both should crash)

testShield.title: Test Shield
testShield.description: With a shield up, run into one tall block on purpose

platformAction.title: Platform Action
platformAction.description: 'handle' climbs ramps, jumps onto steps and avoids walls; 'ignore' runs straight into them (should crash)

gapAction.title: Gap Action
gapAction.description: 'handle' jumps holes and crosses floating stones; 'ignore' runs straight on (should fall in)

testStumble.title: Test Stumble
testStumble.description: 'once' clips a block from the side on purpose (should stumble, not crash); 'twice' does it again inside the warning window (should crash)

dodgeLead.title: Dodge Lead (s)
dodgeLead.description: How far ahead (in seconds) to start dodging a block; about 0.2 makes every dodge a close call

challenge.title: Challenge Code
challenge.description: Play this challenge link code (the part after ?c=); empty for a normal run

shieldTime.title: Shield (s)
shieldTime.description: Or until it absorbs one hit

window.title: Combo Window (s)
window.description: Time to land the next trick before the combo resets
